programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil

But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Count
programme.desc: Two gunmen ride into a town with a plan to collect a large unearned bounty but are caught up in the local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

programme.title: Twice a Judas

As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity

programme.title: Doc, Hands of Steel

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: Sartana and Trinity set out on a grudging relationship hell bent for gold and comic brawls.

programme.title: Day of Anger
programme.desc: Bank robbery pulled off by the bank officials, not the usual James gang.

programme.title: Django the Last Killer

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Between the world we see and the things we fear…There are doors. When they are opened...Nightmares become reality. These are the true stories of the innocent and the unimaginable.

programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team finishes their investigation into the Old Hospital on College Hill, deep in the Appalachian Mountains, a place steeped in a long history of hauntings where shadowy presences, unexplained phenomena, and whispers of unknown evils linger in the darkness, waiting to be discovered. What will they encounter in the shadows—and will they leave unchanged?

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: New Jersey police working the murder of a woman bludgeoned to death in her own bed first think her boyfriend did it. When a desperate family member contacts renowned psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, Nancy sees the boyfriend is innocent, and gives police details that help undo the real killer's alibi. New Orleans investigators are stumped when a young mother turns up beaten to death, her son gravely injured. The suspects-the husband and his friend-blame each other, so investigators turn to psychic Rosemarie Kerr. Tapping into the fallen wife's vibration, Rosemarie discovers a truth more horrifying than anyone imagined.

programme.title: Encounters
programme.desc: After 5 years, Jason returns to the scene of the first location the Encounters crew ever investigated.....Bodmin Jail as his investigation of this mammoth prison alone once again, begins!

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: An investigation into the practice of past-life regression therapy; a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover memories of supposed past lives. In this episode, a young woman anxious to learn why she is afraid to have children travels back to 19th-century, rural America where she re-experiences a tragic loss

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files

The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.

programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.desc: Watch the third race of the 2025 Super Formula championship season at Mobility Resort Motegi.

programme.title: The Road to Success - Emil Frey Lexus Racing Team
programme.desc: Join the Emil Frey Lexus Racing Team as it tackles the world's toughest GT racing - the Blancpain GT Series. Go behind the scenes for all the action and emotion from the Swiss team with exclusive interviews and racing footage!

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1 of the bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal saw fierce battles on a 425 km loop around Grândola. Red Bull KTM’s Daniel Sanders (RallyGP) and Edgar Canet (Rally2) doubled up on their prologue wins, while Thomas Zoldos repeated in Rally3 and Gaëtan Martinez took the quad lead. In cars, Henk Lategan (Toyota) claimed the stage and overall lead ahead of four fellow Toyotas, as Nasser Al Attiyah (Dacia) slipped to eighth after a penalty. Mattias Ekström (Challenger) and Alexandre Pinto (SSV) also triumphed. Stage 2 heads into Spain with the week’s longest test: 655 km, including 429 against the clock.

programme.title: How This Troubled Car Drove F1's Greatest Qualifying Lap
programme.desc: From Senna to Schumacher to Hamilton, there are some great qualifiers in Formula 1, but who exactly has had the best qualifying lap in F1 history? In this episode of Autosport’s “Short View Back to the Past” series, Chief Editor Kevin Turner picks out F1’s greatest qualifying laps.

programme.title: How Controversy at Imola Changed F1 Forever
programme.desc: Imola kicks off the European Formula 1 season in 2022 - the track has a rich history, but it’s also one filled with drama, controversy and tragedy – from intra-team fights to battles for the control of the sport and one of motorsport’s worst weekends. In the latest of our new "A Short View Back to the Past" series, Autosport's Chief Editor Kevin Turner takes a look at some of the most important moments in Imola’s rollercoaster story.

programme.title: The fastest F1 cars to never win a championship
programme.desc: Some cars obliterate the F1 field but once in a while, luck runs out and even the fastest cars and drivers can't win. In the latest of Autosport’s “Short View Back to the Past” series, Chief Editor Kevin Turner reveals F1’s fastest failures.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E06 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 4: Hell Verse [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.

But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. - Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. - One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they’ll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods’ calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand’s north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country’s most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Human life today would be very different if our ancestors had not stopped hunting animal protein. In the Fertile Crescent - known today as the Middle East - humans travelled in nomadic groups of hunter-gatherers and ate what they killed.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: When our ancestors saw how other animals kept warm in sub-freezing temperatures, they started hunting them for their hides and fur. As hominid evolution was diverging from other primates, they lost their thick covering of fur when the mercury dropped.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: Sharks of the Icy North
programme.desc: We mostly know the nimble predators from the depths of tropical seas. At the same time very little is known about the sharks of the icy North.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. Despite our best efforts, we are vulnerable - not, perhaps, to lions, tigers, and bears - but more to the killers we can’t even see. In America during the early 1980s, a mysterious new disease claims the lives of 159 people, most of them gay men.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: As a species, we believe we are more than just animals. We are inspired to express ourselves through words, art, music, and scientific endeavours. Our ancestors painted animals on cave walls - usually large mammals, like bison and deer. Animals were out first artistic subject, our first inspiration.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe's history has many dark sides, but its culture is more than a small gleam of hope, it radiates in many areas far out into the world. The old continent sets standards in art, literature and science. Starting with the ancient Greeks, Europe produces a number of smart and creative minds: from Aristotle to Michelangelo and Einstein, from Beethoven to the Beatles.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has been a battle concept for centuries: it often takes foreign enemies to weld the Europeans together. But for centuries, they are primarily fighting against themselves. It was not until the Enlightenment and the French Revolution of 1789 that a new idea of Europe emerged based on common values: freedom, equality and fraternalism.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has never experienced such a long period of peace and prosperity as after the Second World War. When the Iron Curtain falls in 1989, the dream of a Europe united in peace and freedom seems finally to become reality. But whether financial or refugee crisis - the European euphoria has disappeared, nationalists are on the rise again.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programme.desc: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programme.desc: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Cessna 195"
programme.desc: Kurtis takes us up in the aircraft that’s a crowd favorite wherever it he takes it. We spend some time with an ever-growing group of people who use their planes as campers and for one week a year, the tower at Oshkosh’s Wittman Regional Airport becomes the busiest on the planet.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aviation 101"
programme.desc: An explanation of some of the very basics of aviation.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Future of Living Part 2"
programme.desc: Learn about trends and technologies in the smart kitchen, the digitization of living spaces and changes due to the pandemic and the home office.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "World Ex"
programme.desc: Get excited with a digital car competition that pits teams from around the world against each other on digital race tracks, with the goal of protecting the environment.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Planet Makers"
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hawaii"
programme.desc: We have filmed extensively in Hawaii, filming big-wave surfing at the famous Banzai Pipeline on Oahu’s North Shore, and filming George surfing with the “Hawaian Fire” firefighters. We have also filmed at the Hawaii Tsunami Institute and in Hilo.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Italia Wild"
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"
programme.desc: Mt.Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker:High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Cross Trainers, 3D Printers and Turnstiles"
programme.desc: Cross-trainer, 3D printer, food mixer, frozen yoghurt maker, turnstile and office chair... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Fighting Mortality"
programme.desc: What is the secret to eternal life? Alie Ward goes from an ancient herbal remedy to arrive at embryonic stem cells and the tantalising prospect of a future where we could be forever young.

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Ice Bombs"
programme.desc: Alex heads to America search of a scientific explanation for the terrifying phenomenon known as Ice Bombs, which cause fear, devastation and even injury.

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Alien Sounds"
programme.desc: Mysterious, alien sky sounds terrify Canadian residents, who struggle to locate their source.

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Birds"
programme.desc: Host Alex heads to Arkansas, USA to investigate a Bird Apocalypse where the bodies of thousands of blackbirds rained down from the sky.

programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Killer Mice"
programme.desc: Alex heads to South Australia to investigate a terrifying rodent infestation.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S1 - "Operation Clear-Out"
programme.desc: Military WW2 dealer Bruce Crompton is clearing out his messy warehouse and finds some long-forgotten treasures. Can he sell them for a big profit?

programme.title: Combat Dealers S1 - "Hollywood's Calling"
programme.desc: A Hollywood movie is being shot and they need genuine military vehicles. Bruce could make a lot of money, but are his props good enough to seal the deal?

programme.title: Combat Dealers S2 - "Phillippines"
programme.desc: Bruce Crompton is back! Follow the fortunes of bruce and his specialist team as they buy, restore and sell WW2 military vehicles and memorabilia.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S2 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Bruce and Hus head to freezing Finland following a hot tip. Up near the Arctic Circle there's a kind of Winder Wonderland of World War Two vehicles and equipment.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Height"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard four spectacular rollercoasters in Europe and America that exploit our fear of heights.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Inversion"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four roller coasters in Europe and America that use inversions, or loops, to create thrilling rides.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Longest"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four of the longest roller coasters in Europe and America.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Psychological"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four theme park rides in Europe and America which use psychological tricks to add to the thrills.

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Snowboarding"
programme.desc: How do innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe?

programme.title: Ghost Chasers S1 - "Hastings"
programme.desc: The team investigate paranormal activity in Hastings where Ian Lawman makes contact with the spirit of the notorious devil worshipper Aleister Crowley.

programme.title: Ghost Chasers S1 - "Harwich"
programme.desc: Kay Nambiar and the team are in Harwich, South East England to investigate a pair of haunted lighthouses capturing ghostly orbs on their CCTV cameras.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?"
programme.sub-title: Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?
programme.desc: Our long-term survival on this planet depends on advanced satellites keeping us connected and keeping an eye on the Earth from orbit.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space Pirates"
programme.desc: Between advanced satellites and tons of precious resources the future of space exploration looks to be highly profitable.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Mad Scientists In Outer Space"
programme.desc: The unique properties of space make it ideal for some world-changing and unique scientific experiments.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space As A Tax Haven"
programme.desc: For the ultra-wealthy, the best part of making money is avoiding taxes. Space could be an astronomical payday, but will all that profit slip by tax free?

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Final Years"
programme.desc: THE SPACE SHUTTLE MATURES - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. COMPLEX CONSTRUCTION IN SPACE - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers forget the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Ice Giants"
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Moons of Olympus"

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

World premiere at Sheffield Doc/Fest 2018.

programme.title: The Hobby
programme.desc: A McDonald’s Happy Meal shortage. A security guard escort. Guns pulled in a Target parking lot. All of these are caused by a common factor: trading cards. In 2020, a new BOOM began. For the first time, large hedge funds, celebrities like Logan Paul and Steve Aoki, nostalgic millennials, entrepreneurs like Josh Luber, and billionaires scrambled to add sports, Pokémon, and other hot item cards to their collections and portfolios. Over the next two years, the hobby exploded — even causing card grading services to shut down due to overwhelming customer service. This documentary is a character-driven feel good deep dive into the high-stakes, eccentric world of card collecting, following buyers, sellers, card shop owners, graders, online streamers, auctioneers, and more, who all participate in the hobby in their own unique ways. Directed by Morgan Jon Fox.

programme.title: Wildfire

Directed by Andree Ljutica.

Joined by Peppe, a passionate percussionist devoted to preserving Sicily’s ancestral beat, they weave a timeless narrative of tradition, connection, and the enduring heartbeat of the drum across generations. programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los nuevos amigos de Daryl encuentran a Rick y pretenden violar a Michonne y Carl para después matar a los tres. Mientras, Glenn, Maggie, Sasha, Bob, Tara, Abraham, Eugene y Rosita se dan cuenta de que Terminus no es el paraíso que imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los supervivientes de Woodbury se han unido al grupo de Rick en la prisión, crían animales, cultivan y todo parece ir bien. Sin embargo, el grupo va a descubrir que el peligro no siempre llega desde afuera.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick establece una cuarentena para evitar que el virus se propague entre la población de la cárcel. Tyreese descubre que alguien ha asesinado y quemado los cadáveres de su novia y su amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl encabeza un grupo que sale de la cárcel en busca de medicamentos y, durante el trayecto, oyen por radio que alguien habla de un santuario. Rick averigua quién asesinó a Karen y David y por qué lo hizo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Carol salen en busca de comida y ocurre algo que cambia su relación para siempre. Mientras, el otro grupo sigue buscando medicinas y, durante la misión, Bob le confiesa a Tyreese que es alcohólico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La salud de los enfermos empeora drásticamente aunque Hershel trate de salvar sus vidas como pueda. Rick revela a Maggie qué ha pasado con Carol, mientras que en las murallas de la prisión una muchedumbre de zombis amenaza con destruir la valla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras la caída de Woodbury, el Gobernador vaga sin rumbo hasta que encuentra a una familia cuyo patriarca está moribundo. El Gobernador se encariña especialmente con Lilly, una niña autista a la que promete proteger siempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador se da cuenta de que el grupo de Martínez es débil, a pesar de que tienen un gran arsenal. Además, localiza a quienes le arrebataron todo lo que tenía.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador captura a Hershel y Michonne y exige al grupo salir de la prisión. Sin embargo, Rick y su gente no van a dejarse vencer sin presentar batalla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Después de la batalla contra el Gobernador, Rick y Carl encuentran una casa en la que Rick intenta reponerse de sus graves heridas y Carl sale en busca de alimentos. Mientras, Michonne trata de encontrarlos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los sobrevivientes del ataque vagan por el bosque, diseminados en grupos pequeños, en busca de cobijo. Tyreese, Lizzie y Mika se topan con una antigua conocida. Mientras, Daryl y Beth buscan a los demás y Glenn despierta en la prisión solo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Carl y Michonne se encuentran con un grupo de hombres extremadamente peligrosos en una casa aparentemente vacía. Mientras, Glenn y Tara conocen a unas personas que viajan hacia Washington D. C.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Beth siguen viajando juntos y Beth le revela que no quiere morir sin haber probado nunca el alcohol. A pesar de que Daryl se muestra contrario a sus intenciones, Beth se emborracha y, de esta forma, ambos se conocen mejor.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Tyreese llegan a las inmediaciones de Terminus y descubren que sus amigos están retenidos y van a ser sacrificados para ser comidos. Ahora, el destino de todo el grupo depende de ellos dos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick vaga por el bosque y encuentra a Gabriel, un párroco al que salvan de una horda de zombis y les permite pernoctar en su iglesia. Sin embargo, hay algo extraño en él y esa misma noche uno de los integrantes del grupo es secuestrado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gareth y su grupo de caníbales atacan la iglesia mientras Rick y sus compañeros están en el bosque buscándolos para vengar a Bob. Además, el padre Gabriel confiesa el siniestro acto de su pasado que no deja descansar a su conciencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Beth se despierta en un hospital de Atlanta, pero pronto se da cuenta de que los mismos que la auxiliaron y sanaron no la dejarán marchar. No obstante, su nuevo amigo, Noah, y ella tratan de huir del recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras se dirigen hacia el norte, el grupo se ve obligado a detenerse porque una horda de zombis bloquea el camino. La tensión aumenta y la situación termina por estallar cuando Eugene confiesa un secreto que había ocultado a todos hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl persiguen a los captores de Beth por una Atlanta devastada, pero su auto se queda sin gasolina y deben pasar la noche en un refugio para mujeres.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Noah regresan a la iglesia para pedirles ayuda a sus compañeros. Rick y otros integrantes del grupo van a Atlanta con la intención de secuestrar a varios policías para intercambiarlos por Beth y Carol.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick busca una salida pacífica al conflicto, pero sus enemigos la rechazan y prefieren zanjar las cosas de forma violenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: Lo que pasó y lo que está sucediendo
programme.desc: Para cumplir con la promesa que Beth le hizo Noah antes de morir, el grupo se dirige al barrio de Noah, esperando hallar allí protección y a otros supervivientes. Sin embargo, Rick y los suyos no quieren hacerse demasiadas esperanzas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El vehículo se avería y el grupo continúa a pie hacia Washington D. C., pero les sorprende una tormenta y buscan cobijo en un granero, donde encuentran algo totalmente inesperado e inquietante.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Aaron invita al grupo a Alexandria, su comunidad, un lugar que, según él, es seguro y amigable. Rick, incapaz de olvidar Woodbury y Terminus, desconfía de Aaron, pero Michonne quiere darle una oportunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los integrantes del grupo tienen entrevistas con Deanna, la jefa de Alexandria, y esperan en las casas que les asignan a saber si son aceptados o rechazados. Cuando conocen a los habitantes de la comunidad, perciben que no están bien entrenados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Daryl y Carol se reúnen en secreto para planear cómo recuperar sus armas del arsenal de Alexandria, ya que temen que, si algo sale mal, van a necesitarlas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol le sugiere a Rick que deben asesinar a Pete porque es violento con su esposa e hijo. Por otra parte, Gabriel advierte a Deanna que desconfíe del grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna y Rick se culpan mutuamente de las muertes de Aidenn y Noah. Rick le ofrece a Jessie protección ante Pete, pero este lo descubre y se enzarza en una pelea con él. La tensión en Alexandria aumenta y algo terrible se avecina.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna quiere expulsar al grupo de Rick de Alexandria y ellos se preparan para defenderse. Sin embargo, la llegada de una banda de asaltantes y la irrupción de una horda de zombis interrumpen el enfrentamiento entre los dos bandos.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore the Bauhaus Legacy in Dessau, Germany. The Bauhaus is the 20th century’s most influential art, architecture, and design school that inspired a mindset and style known as Modernism. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she visits iconic Bauhaus Buildings earning Dessau a UNESCO World Heritage Site designation. The industrial city in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt holds the world’s largest collection of Bauhaus buildings. Much of the city’s Bauhaus architecture traces back to The Bauhaus School, which relocated to Dessau from Weimar in 1925.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luís Fernando esta con Felicita y Tatiana, la primera esta furiosa y le pregunta que quien es la asistente que lo esta ayudando en la oficina, el para no enredar mas la cosa le dice que es una amiga de Santiago y se despide dejándolas allí, Felicita que ni sospecha nada de Tatiana le pide justo a esta que la ayude averiguar quien es esa fulana asistente. Dileidy sube al techo de su casa para poder llorar sin que nadie la vea y sorpresa ya se encontraba allí Aureliano, quien le dice que no se preocupe, y le empieza a decir cosas de su novio, el tiene reconcomio por que ella no le para a el, en cambio si sufre por otro, en ese momento la llama Luís Fernando ella duda si le contesta o no y es el mismo Aureliano quien la convence de que le conteste la llamada, se hace la loca cuando lo saluda y Luís Fernando la invita para una última cita, por lo que Dileidy acepto ir, lo que no sabes es que Luís Fernando lo que quiere es ser el quien termine con la relación y no que sea ella quien lo humille. Yuraima cree que Gladis se comió el cuento de que ella estuvo trabajando en la casa de Egleé, Gladis para terminar de convencerse le pone la última concha de mango, le pregunta si Egleé estaba con su esposo tomando el desayuno, Yuraima le dice que si, que es una pareja muy bella y todo lo demás, Gladis explota y le arma tremendo lío ahora solo esta esperando que llegue Dileidy para hacerle el reclamo a ella. Dileidy le dice a su amiga que su mamá todavía no descubre nada aún, que se comió el cuento completo, se despide de Yennilu y cuando llega a su casa la esta esperando Gladis echa una fiera, pero controlada, le dice a su hija que por que le mintió que ya ella sabe que fue ella la que fue a la casa de Egleé a cachifear y no Yuraima como ella había acordado, al verse descubierta no lo quedo mas remedio a Dileidy que reconocer que si es verdad, que lo hizo para que su mamá no perdiera el empleo, a Gladis le conmovió mucho eso pues no quiere que su hija sea una sirvienta como ella, la mujer tiene otros planes para su hija la quiere graduada, con un futuro promisorio no marginal e ignorante como ella, otra cosa que le preocupa a Gladis es que paso en la casa de Egleé con Luís Fernando, Dileidy le dice que nada que no paso nada, que puede estar tranquila por que el nunca se fijará en una cachifa, que ese no es su caso, Gladis sin embargo no esta tranquila. Rómulo entra al garaje y se pone a tocar guitarra, entra Egleé y el sorprendido le dice que se va, ella trata de decirle que no se vaya que puede estar tranquilo que ella no es así, el que como que no esta de muy buen humor, empieza la polémica, le dice a Egleé que si se vana divorciar, pero que no será como su mamá lo acuerde que el también tendrá su abogado, y que abra pelea, pues esa también es su casa y peleará sus derechos, bueno Egleé por su lado tampoco se queda atrás y empezaron a decirse todo tipo de cosas, Cristina que esta tratando de escuchar, le dice a Luís Fernando que ella cree que sus padres se están reconciliando, el que sabe de esas cosas y esta mas claro, le dice que no será así que se baje de esa nube, en ese momento salen del garaje Rómulo y Egleé y continúan peleando, Cristina se da cuenta que su hermano tenía razón. Matilde esta decidida a trabajar de nuevo, en la mañana esta preparándose para ir a una entrevista de trabajo cuando Gonzalo se entera, se molesta un poco, Matilde le dice que lo quiere solidario que la apoye un poco, el no entiende y no disimula. Gabriel aconseja a Aureliano que sea mas emprendedor para poder conquistar a Dileidy, por que el reconoce que su hijo le queda corto a esa muchacha, entonces le dice que cambie de táctica, Theo esta desesperado buscando empleo, para poder llevar a la nena a comer, ahora piensa meterse en un grupo de mariachis, la llama y ella cree que es pasa salir y se lleva otra decepción es por que quiso escucharla, la hija la anima a que continúe con esa ilusión. Betsaida llega al restaurante donde esta Rómulo tomándose unos tragos, el la invita y ahí empieza a contarle cosas de su vida, a ella le parece muy interesante todo lo que el dice. Pascuita esta pidiéndole a su hija que la ayude con la limpieza de la casa, Ramón observa y luego comenta todo cuanto ha cambiado su esposa, el la conoció ejecutiva y ahora se preocupa por una cosa tan cotidiana como el aseo del hogar, Pascuita se pone alerta. Dileidy le cuenta Yennilu que su mamá descubrió todo, menos lo del novio claro esta, ahora lo que quiere es que se le olvide un poco la cuestión y confía en que en una semana se le haya pasado la cuestión, pero como que no conoce bien a su mamá pues Gladis no iba a estar tranquila, y se fue a la casa de Egleé, en la entrada de la casa se encuentra nada mas que a Luís Fernando y ahí mismo empieza a preguntarle que le pareció su hija.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Julio se aparece en la casa de Ruth y Domingo y le pide a ella que se aleje de una vez por todas de la familia Humboldt. Sin embargo, ella está decidida a luchar por el amor que tiene hacia Josue. Mientras Macarena y Jeremías hablan, Josue se presenta y les comunica que ella debe acompañarlo a la Unidad de Homicidios para ser interrogada. Cuando regresan, se enteran del secuestro de Inmaculada, pero deciden no comunicarle nada a Vespasiano. Vicenta comienza a trabajar en el Centro de Ayudas como le asignó la jueza. Es así como encuentra un papel que archiva la dirección donde se encuentra José Guillermo.

Betsaida llega al restaurante donde esta Rómulo tomándose unos tragos, el la invita y ahí empieza a contarle cosas de su vida, a ella le parece muy interesante todo lo que el dice. Pascuita esta pidiéndole a su hija que la ayude con la limpieza de la casa, Ramón observa y luego comenta todo cuanto ha cambiado su esposa, el la conoció ejecutiva y ahora se preocupa por una cosa tan cotidiana como el aseo del hogar, Pascuita se pone alerta. Dileidy le cuenta Yennilu que su mamá descubrió todo, menos lo del novio claro esta, ahora lo que quiere es que se le olvide un poco la cuestión y confía en que en una semana se le haya pasado la cuestión, pero como que no conoce bien a su mamá pues Gladis no iba a estar tranquila, y se fue a la casa de Egleé, en la entrada de la casa se encuentra nada mas que a Luís Fernando y ahí mismo empieza a preguntarle que le pareció su hija.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Julio se aparece en la casa de Ruth y Domingo y le pide a ella que se aleje de una vez por todas de la familia Humboldt. Sin embargo, ella está decidida a luchar por el amor que tiene hacia Josue. Mientras Macarena y Jeremías hablan, Josue se presenta y les comunica que ella debe acompañarlo a la Unidad de Homicidios para ser interrogada. Cuando regresan, se enteran del secuestro de Inmaculada, pero deciden no comunicarle nada a Vespasiano. Vicenta comienza a trabajar en el Centro de Ayudas como le asignó la jueza. Es así como encuentra un papel que archiva la dirección donde se encuentra José Guillermo.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luís Fernando esta con Felicita y Tatiana, la primera esta furiosa y le pregunta que quien es la asistente que lo esta ayudando en la oficina, el para no enredar mas la cosa le dice que es una amiga de Santiago y se despide dejándolas allí, Felicita que ni sospecha nada de Tatiana le pide justo a esta que la ayude averiguar quien es esa fulana asistente. Dileidy sube al techo de su casa para poder llorar sin que nadie la vea y sorpresa ya se encontraba allí Aureliano, quien le dice que no se preocupe, y le empieza a decir cosas de su novio, el tiene reconcomio por que ella no le para a el, en cambio si sufre por otro, en ese momento la llama Luís Fernando ella duda si le contesta o no y es el mismo Aureliano quien la convence de que le conteste la llamada, se hace la loca cuando lo saluda y Luís Fernando la invita para una última cita, por lo que Dileidy acepto ir, lo que no sabes es que Luís Fernando lo que quiere es ser el quien termine con la relación y no que sea ella quien lo humille. Yuraima cree que Gladis se comió el cuento de que ella estuvo trabajando en la casa de Egleé, Gladis para terminar de convencerse le pone la última concha de mango, le pregunta si Egleé estaba con su esposo tomando el desayuno, Yuraima le dice que si, que es una pareja muy bella y todo lo demás, Gladis explota y le arma tremendo lío ahora solo esta esperando que llegue Dileidy para hacerle el reclamo a ella. Dileidy le dice a su amiga que su mamá todavía no descubre nada aún, que se comió el cuento completo, se despide de Yennilu y cuando llega a su casa la esta esperando Gladis echa una fiera, pero controlada, le dice a su hija que por que le mintió que ya ella sabe que fue ella la que fue a la casa de Egleé a cachifear y no Yuraima como ella había acordado, al verse descubierta no lo quedo mas remedio a Dileidy que reconocer que si es verdad, que lo hizo para que su mamá no perdiera el empleo, a Gladis le conmovió mucho eso pues no quiere que su hija sea una sirvienta como ella, la mujer tiene otros planes para su hija la quiere graduada, con un futuro promisorio no marginal e ignorante como ella, otra cosa que le preocupa a Gladis es que paso en la casa de Egleé con Luís Fernando, Dileidy le dice que nada que no paso nada, que puede estar tranquila por que el nunca se fijará en una cachifa, que ese no es su caso, Gladis sin embargo no esta tranquila. Rómulo entra al garaje y se pone a tocar guitarra, entra Egleé y el sorprendido le dice que se va, ella trata de decirle que no se vaya que puede estar tranquilo que ella no es así, el que como que no esta de muy buen humor, empieza la polémica, le dice a Egleé que si se vana divorciar, pero que no será como su mamá lo acuerde que el también tendrá su abogado, y que abra pelea, pues esa también es su casa y peleará sus derechos, bueno Egleé por su lado tampoco se queda atrás y empezaron a decirse todo tipo de cosas, Cristina que esta tratando de escuchar, le dice a Luís Fernando que ella cree que sus padres se están reconciliando, el que sabe de esas cosas y esta mas claro, le dice que no será así que se baje de esa nube, en ese momento salen del garaje Rómulo y Egleé y continúan peleando, Cristina se da cuenta que su hermano tenía razón. Matilde esta decidida a trabajar de nuevo, en la mañana esta preparándose para ir a una entrevista de trabajo cuando Gonzalo se entera, se molesta un poco, Matilde le dice que lo quiere solidario que la apoye un poco, el no entiende y no disimula. Leonardo tiene cinco hijos y es viudo, el mayor de sus hijos se desaparece de su casa sin decir nada a nadie. Leonardo muy enojado por la actitud de su hijo le ordena a Irene que le cancele las tarjetas a su hijo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra acepta casarse con Leonardo. Irene queda destrozada por haberse ilusionado con Leonardo, pero trata de disimular ante la gente su dolor. Alejandra y Leonardo deciden contar su noticia a Carlos y Juan Pablo quienes se alegran al oírla y deciden brindar por ello. Rodrigo se aparece en la empresa Ferrándiz y también los felicita a Leonardo y Alejandra por la idea de casarse.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra es sorprendida por Rodrigo en el estacionamiento de la empresa, donde discuten pero luego terminan a los besos, cuando están besándose son vistos por Irene que justo baja al estacionamiento a buscar el portafolios de Leonardo. Irene se sorprende y se esconde, pero cuando sale huyendo es vista por Alejandra, quien luego le va a recriminar que no diga nada de lo que vio a Leonardo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene va al hospital a visitar a Virginia y se encuentra con su abogado Felipe, quien la acompaña en este momento tan difícil y trata de que el trámite de reducción de pena no se eche atrás. Carlos y Alejandra tienen una pequeña charla en donde Carlos le plantea que ella no podría hacerse cargo de los hijos de Leonardo como lo hace Irene, Alejandra enfurece.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra discute con Irene para que no vaya a decir una sola palabra de lo que vio en el estacionamiento. Leonardo, Juan Pablo, Carlos y Alejandra mantienen una conversación respecto a la estafa que quería provocarles Rodrigo. Alejandra le pide permiso a Leonardo para poder investigar. Virginia tiene la visita de Jimena al hospital y esta la amenaza con que no siga intentado reducir su pena.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene le confiesa a Carlos que está enamorada de Leonardo y que espera que algún día Leonardo se dé cuenta que Alejandra es una mala persona. Alejandra y Rodrigo discuten por el dinero que perdieron y piensan en nuevos planes para destruir a los Ferrándiz. Leo les plantea a sus amigos que le va a reclamar a su papá la herencia de su madre para poder irse a vivir solo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: A Virginia le dan el alta del hospital y vuelve a la cárcel. Felipe le exige a la directora de la cárcel más seguridad para su cliente. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victor culpa a su padre y su tío de la desgracia que está viviendo, y le dice a Chacorta que ellos solo siembran muerte y destrucción en la familia. Mónica está desconsolada tras perder al bebé.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerra entre bandas del narcotráfico apenas comienza. Aurelio promete venganza: sugiere a Chacorta que trasladen el negocio a España y vigilen a Chema, quien podría escapar de prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pantaleón es secuestrado por Tostado y Tijeras, quienes lo torturan. Aurelio retoma sus negocios con el general Montoya, cambia de planes y viaja a Colombia para comenzar su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Chacorta que mató al Tostado, y aunque vengó a Victor, aún no ha terminado. Anuncia nuevos negocios con Venezuela y dice que comenzará a llamarse Danilo Ferro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa tiene que ceder para ayudar al Chema a escapar de prisión. Leonor tiene secretos insospechados, y planea usar a Ximena de carnada para atrapar a líderes del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: Rancho Esperanza
programme.desc: Una joven lo tiene todo: un hermoso rancho, un caballo llamado Faith y el amor de su familia. Pero tras la muerte de su padre, un militar, ella y su madre corren el riesgo de perder también el rancho familiar. Con un poco de ayuda de sus amigos y de su majestuoso caballo blanco, urden un plan para reunir el dinero suficiente para salvar el rancho mientras aprenden a no perder nunca la esperanza, a pesar de todo.

programme.title: Cambio De Rumbo
programme.desc: Después de recibir malas noticias sobre la salud de su padre, James regresa a casa de mala gana para ayudar con el negocio familiar, un alojamiento y desayuno. Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.
